title: Lime House Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Lime House is a 2 BR / 2 BA / 6 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Located on the east side of Seaside on quiet secluded Robert’s Way and very near to the beach is Lime House.
description_expanded: Description40 ROBERT'S WAY1 KING, 1 FULL (in loft), 2 TWINS, (Twin bedroom can be converted to King upon request)A Secluded Seaside Retreat Near the BeachWelcome to Lime House, a charming coastal hideaway tucked along the quiet, tree-lined Robert’s Way on the east side of Seaside, Florida. Located just 176 yards (a 2-minute walk) from the beach, this thoughtfully positioned home offers a rare sense of privacy while remaining close to all that Seaside has to offer. Overlooking Rosewalk Park, often described as a secret garden, Lime House provides peaceful, leafy views where children can play freely and adults can unwind from the comfort of the upstairs balcony.Recently Renovated with Coastal EleganceRecently renovated with exceptional attention to detail, Lime House blends modern comfort with relaxed coastal charm. Its versatile layout makes it equally ideal for families, couples traveling together, or guests seeking a serene Seaside escape just steps from the beach.First Floor: Two Private Bedroom SuitesThe first level features two beautifully appointed bedroom suites, each designed for comfort and privacy.The king primary suite includes a spacious en suite bathroom with a double vanity, a large walk-in shower, and custom-built closets offering ample storage.The second bedroom is thoughtfully adaptable, featuring two twin beds that can be converted into a king upon request, creating the option for two king primary suites. This room also includes a newly designed bathroom with a large indoor shower that connects directly to a private outdoor shower, perfect after a day at the Seaside beach.Second Floor: Open Living, Kitchen & BalconyUpstairs, the home opens into a bright, welcoming living space designed for gathering and relaxation. The fully equipped chef’s kitchen features Bertazzoni stainless steel appliances, a farmhouse sink, and a gas stovetop and oven, ideal for preparing meals at home. A custom built-in dining nook comfortably seats six, while the open-concept living area boasts soaring ceilings and walls of windows that fill the space with natural light.Glass doors lead to a spacious, furnished second-floor balcony complete with a porch swing—an inviting spot to enjoy morning coffee or evening breezes while overlooking the treetops of Rosewalk Park. This level also includes a fully renovated third full bathroom for added convenience.Third Floor: Bonus Loft SpaceThe third level offers a bonus loft with a full bed, making it an ideal hideaway for children or additional guests. This flexible space enhances the home’s layout and adds to its appeal for families and small groups.Your Favorite Seaside GetawayWith private park views, a location just six homes from the beach, and new exterior decking with a grilling area, Lime House is perfectly suited for both adventure-filled family vacations and peaceful coastal retreats. Whether you're exploring Seaside’s iconic streets or relaxing under the trees of Rosewalk Park, this home invites you to slow down and truly enjoy life by the Gulf.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES1,100 square feet80 steps to Scenic Highway 30A; 176 yards (2-minute walk) to beach accessSeaside Private Residential Beach at Tupelo Pavilion, one of the largest private residential beaches on 30ASecond bedroom configured with two twin beds, convertible to a king upon requestThree full bathrooms, including two en suite bathsTwo private outdoor showersPeacock Alley premium linens, featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeFull-size washer and dryerAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes included with your stay for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued (a golf cart is considered a car; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners). Special circumstances and medical needs may request a golf cart permit.STR23-002168
